'''Bartell Issk''' was a sewer technician in [[Selkren]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. He was middle-aged, and spent some of his time in [[Mazzoney]]'s [[Mazzoney's|cantina]].<ref name="I" />
